mapper.select: SELECT c.END_DATE FROM CHALLENGE c WHERE c.CODE = #{code} AND c.DELETE_YN = 0 AND c.PROGRESS_STATUS = 'ENDED' AND c.END_DATE <= #{now} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql:
target_challenge AS ( SELECT c.CODE, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE,
CASE WHEN c.END_DATE > c.START_DATE THEN DATEDIFF( DATE(DATE_SUB(c.END_DATE, INTERVAL 1 SECOND)), DATE(c.START_DATE) ) + 1 ELSE NULL END AS GOAL_DAYS
FROM CHALLENGE c WHERE c.CODE = #{code} ),
participants AS ( SELECT ce.MEM_CODE, MIN(ce.JOINED_AT) AS JOINED_AT,
MAX( CASE WHEN ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS COMPLETED
FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce WHERE ce.CHAL_CODE = #{code} AND ce.STATUS IN ('JOINED', 'COMPLETED') AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY ce.MEM_CODE ),
eligible_proofs AS ( SELECT f.CODE, f.MEM_CODE, f.CREATED_AT, DATE(f.CREATED_AT) AS PROOF_DATE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FEED_HIT_LOG hit WHERE hit.FEED_CODE = f.CODE ) AS VIEW_COUNT
FROM FEED f
JOIN target_challenge c ON c.CODE = f.CHAL_CODE
JOIN participants p ON p.MEM_CODE = f.MEM_CODE
WHERE f.DELETE_YN = 0 AND f.CREATED_AT >= c.START_DATE AND f.CREATED_AT < #{endedAt} AND f.CREATED_AT >= p.JOINED_AT )

,
proof_likes AS ( SELECT fl.FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT
FROM FEED_LIKE fl
JOIN eligible_proofs ep ON ep.CODE = fl.FEED_CODE
WHERE fl.DELETE_YN = 0 GROUP BY fl.FEED_CODE ),
scored_proofs AS ( SELECT ep.CODE, ep.MEM_CODE, ep.PROOF_DATE, ep.VIEW_COUNT, COALESCE(pl.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT,
( CAST(ep.VIEW_COUNT AS SIGNED) + COALESCE(pl.LIKE_COUNT, 0) * 10 ) AS SCORE
FROM eligible_proofs ep
LEFT JOIN proof_likes pl ON pl.FEED_CODE = ep.CODE ),
proof_stats AS ( SELECT MEM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS PROOF_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT PROOF_DATE) AS PROOF_DAYS
FROM eligible_proofs GROUP BY MEM_CODE ),
member_metrics AS ( SELECT p.MEM_CODE, p.COMPLETED,
COALESCE(ps.PROOF_COUNT, 0) AS PROOF_COUNT, COALESCE(ps.PROOF_DAYS, 0) AS PROOF_DAYS,
COALESCE( LEAST( 100.0, 100.0 * COALESCE(ps.PROOF_DAYS, 0) / NULLIF(c.GOAL_DAYS, 0) ), 0 ) AS ACHIEVEMENT_RATE
FROM participants p
CROSS JOIN target_challenge c
LEFT JOIN proof_stats ps ON ps.MEM_CODE = p.MEM_CODE )
mapper.select:
WITH ,
daily_candidates AS ( SELECT sp.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sp.MEM_CODE, sp.PROOF_DATE ORDER BY sp.SCORE DESC, sp.CODE ASC ) AS DAILY_ORDER
FROM scored_proofs sp ),
member_scores AS ( SELECT MEM_CODE, SUM(VIEW_COUNT) AS SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, SUM(LIKE_COUNT) AS SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, SUM(SCORE) AS TOTAL_SCORE
FROM daily_candidates WHERE DAILY_ORDER = 1 GROUP BY MEM_CODE ),
member_totals AS ( SELECT mm.MEM_CODE, mm.PROOF_COUNT, mm.PROOF_DAYS, mm.ACHIEVEMENT_RATE,
COALESCE(ms.SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, 0) AS SCORED_VIEW_COUNT,
COALESCE(ms.SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS SCORED_LIKE_COUNT,
COALESCE(ms.TOTAL_SCORE, 0) AS TOTAL_SCORE
FROM member_metrics mm
LEFT JOIN member_scores ms ON ms.MEM_CODE = mm.MEM_CODE ),
ranked AS ( SELECT mt.*,
RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY mt.TOTAL_SCORE DESC, mt.PROOF_DAYS DESC ) AS RANK_NO
FROM member_totals mt )
SELECT r.RANK_NO, r.MEM_CODE AS MEMBER_CODE, m.ID AS MEMBER_ID,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = r.MEM_CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS PROFILE_IMAGE,
r.PROOF_COUNT, r.PROOF_DAYS, r.SCORED_VIEW_COUNT, r.SCORED_LIKE_COUNT, r.TOTAL_SCORE,
ROUND(r.ACHIEVEMENT_RATE, 1) AS ACHIEVEMENT_RATE
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = r.MEM_CODE
ORDER BY r.RANK_NO ASC, r.MEM_CODE ASC

WITH
SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_proofs ) AS proofCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participants ) AS participantCount,
( SELECT COALESCE( ROUND(AVG(LIKE_COUNT), 1), 0 ) FROM scored_proofs ) AS averageLikeCount,
( SELECT COALESCE( ROUND(AVG(ACHIEVEMENT_RATE), 1), 0 ) FROM member_metrics ) AS averageAchievementRate,
( SELECT COALESCE( ROUND(100.0 * AVG(COMPLETED), 1), 0 ) FROM participants ) AS successRate

WITH
SELECT HOUR(CREATED_AT) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS proofCount
FROM eligible_proofs
GROUP BY HOUR(CREATED_AT) ORDER BY hour ASC

WITH
SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '서울%' THEN '서울' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '부산%' THEN '부산' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '대구%' THEN '대구' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '인천%' THEN '인천' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '광주%' THEN '광주' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '대전%' THEN '대전' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '울산%' THEN '울산' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '세종%' THEN '세종' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경기%' THEN '경기' WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '강원%' THEN '강원'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충북%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충청북%' THEN '충북'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충남%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '충청남%' THEN '충남'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전북%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전라북%' THEN '전북'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전남%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '전라남%' THEN '전남'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경북%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경상북%' THEN '경북'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경남%' OR TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '경상남%' THEN '경남'
WHEN TRIM(m.ADDRESS) LIKE '제주%' THEN '제주'
ELSE '미상' END AS regionName,
COUNT(*) AS participantCount
FROM participants p
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = p.MEM_CODE
GROUP BY regionName ORDER BY participantCount DESC, regionName ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHALLENGE_RESULT ( CHAL_CODE, PROOF_COUNT, PARTICIPANT_COUNT, AVERAGE_LIKE_COUNT, AVERAGE_ACHIEVEMENT_RATE, SUCCESS_RATE, MEMBER_RESULTS_JSON, HOURLY_RESULTS_JSON, REGION_RESULTS_JSON, ENDED_AT, SAVED_AT, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{challengeCode}, #{proofCount}, #{participantCount}, #{averageLikeCount}, #{averageAchievementRate}, #{successRate}, #{memberResultsJson, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{hourlyResultsJson, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{regionResultsJson, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{endedAt}, #{savedAt}, #{status} )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.CODE FROM CHALLENGE c
WHERE c.DELETE_YN = 0 AND c.PROGRESS_STATUS = 'ENDED' AND c.END_DATE <= #{now}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHALLENGE_RESULT r WHERE r.CHAL_CODE = c.CODE )
ORDER BY c.END_DATE ASC, c.CODE ASC
